fact: As of July 2026 CITADEL at the Université virtuelle had built a French-Mooré voice and text translator and a legal chatbot on a corpus of 83,000 French-Mooré sentence pairs, and the BurkimbIA platform offered free Mooré/Dioula translation, transcription and speech synthesis.
title: L’intelligence artificielle au Burkina Faso : mise à jour 2026
